overview.description: The VanEck Utilities TruSector ETF (TRUU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in utilities equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in equity securities of utilities-related US-listed companies. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through exposure to industries such as electric utilities, gas utilities, multi-utilities, water utilities, and independent power producers and energy traders. TRUU was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by VanEck.

holdings.infoBox: TRUU is an equity ETF with a total of 32 individual holdings. The top holdings are NextEra Energy stock at 12.79%, The Southern Company at 7.70%, Duke Energy at 7.19%, Constellation Energy at 6.99%, and American Electric Power Company at 5.20%.
